title: Turkish Holiday Menemen
description: A hearty and flavorful Turkish-inspired breakfast dish, perfect for holidays. Menemen is a traditional Turkish omelette filled with spices and vegetables.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the diced red bell pepper and cook until tender, about 4-5 minutes.
Stir in the crushed tomatoes, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Create 4 wells in the mixture and crack an egg into each well.
Scramble the eggs until cooked through, breaking them up with a spatula.
Stir in the crumbled feta cheese and chopped parsley.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
